stage: V2-R3 root-cause revalidation and minimal-fix design

proposed_mechanisms.name: original_candidate_preservation_ranking_decouple
proposed_mechanisms.summary: Score template-promoted sibling inspirations against their OWN title/tags blob (two-tier: own-blob evidence when present, template-level evidence as floor when absent) instead of hardcoding tagsHit=true and deriving titleHit/subjectPresent solely from the template. Retrieval/inclusion unchanged.

proposed_mechanisms.name: required_multi_term_coverage_plus_isolated_hit_cap
proposed_mechanisms.summary: Add coverageRatio (fraction of query's primary tokens present, not just the longest) gating subjectPresent for multi-token queries; cap the combined whole_token_title+whole_token_tags contribution when a candidate's only evidence is a single isolated whole-token hit with no phrase/coverage corroboration.

excluded_mechanisms.name: dedicated_relaxed_strict_admission_gate
excluded_mechanisms.reason: structurally can only touch WEAK_RELAXED_DILUTION_PARTIAL (10% of regressions, and only partially); cannot reach the 45/50 (90%) explained by ORIGINAL_TEMPLATE_OVERPROMOTION (isOriginal, floor-protected by design) and RELAXED_SCORE_TOO_HIGH_SENSE_COLLISION (already scores above any reasonable floor)

excluded_mechanisms.name: binary_hasStrict_gate_reinstatement
excluded_mechanisms.reason: explicitly prohibited by charter; would re-break V2-R1's confirmed wins (coffee cup, statue, 吉祥物, 贴纸) that came from unifying strict/relaxed into one scored pool

excluded_mechanisms.name: complex_multilayer_admission_gate
excluded_mechanisms.reason: explicitly prohibited by charter; adds surface area without addressing the 90% of regressions outside the relaxed-admission mechanism's reach

excluded_mechanisms.name: large_manual_wrong_sense_blacklist
excluded_mechanisms.reason: explicitly prohibited by charter ("不增加大规模歧义词黑名单"); coverage/isolation rules in mechanism B are general token-overlap arithmetic, not per-word entries

excluded_mechanisms.name: new_llm_call_for_sense_disambiguation
excluded_mechanisms.reason: explicitly prohibited by charter ("不新增LLM请求")

excluded_mechanisms.name: standalone_category_topic_consistency_term
excluded_mechanisms.reason: no case in the 50 regressions was diagnosed as requiring it beyond what mechanism B's coverage/isolation rules already explain; adding an unevidenced signal would violate the minimal-fix / no-mechanical-implementation discipline already established in relevanceScorer.ts's own header comment
